name: Magnetic powder neutron diffraction of GaV4S8 at 1.5 K
plain_name: Magnetic powder neutron diffraction of GaV4S8 at 1.5 K
description: Probe low-temperature magnetic order through neutron diffraction from a powder sample. BT-1 + OC50 is a documented candidate combination, not asserted to be the paper's original instrument.

sources.citation: Investigation of the magnetic ground state of GaV4S8 using powder neutron diffraction
NIST NCNR, BT-1 high-resolution neutron powder diffractometer specifications

reported_equipment: Neutron powder diffraction apparatus in the cited study

requirements.rationale: The selected magnetic-structure measurement is at 1.5 K.
A neutron beamline/detector and suitable cryogenic beam geometry are indispensable.

missing_information: Neutron wavelength, scattering geometry, magnetic phase history, sample amount, absorption and instrument resolution must match the study; these are not inferred from cooling alone.
confirmation_note: Curated bounded procedure from the cited source. User must confirm applicability before an interactive verification. Passing encoded checks does not establish unmodeled performance.
verification_scope: Temperature plus the named indispensable measurement/handling functions; no extrapolation of undocumented performance, pressure, calibration, cleanliness or full facility safety.
